title: Pay for managers and splitting job money fairly
summary: Barnes says a manager should get only a dollar or two extra and he quit a band over a leader taking double.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope
